readout_other: delayed nonmatch-to-sample task; step-down task; novel object recognition; elevated plus maze; laser speckle contrast imaging of CBF; HE, Nissl and Golgi-Cox staining; western blot (TLR4, NF-kB, IL-6, JNK, SYP, NR2B, PSD95, CaMKII)
direction_notes: Neural excitability was not recorded; LIFUS improved working memory in VD rats, increased vascular branches and synaptic proteins and reduced TLR4/NF-kB pathway proteins and IL-6.
safety_notes: Body weight and elevated plus maze anxiety-like behaviour did not differ among groups; authors conclude no weight loss or anxiety-like behaviour was induced.

exposures.label: LIFUS to bilateral mPFC in VD rats

timing.protocol_description: 0.5 MHz, PRF 2.0 kHz, 150 cycles (0.3 ms tone burst), 0.5 s sonication duration, 2 s interstimulus interval, Ispta 500 mW/cm2; 10 min per side per day to bilateral mPFC under 1% isoflurane, daily for 14 days starting 2 weeks after BCCAO.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Then, the survival rats were randomly divided into two subgroups, VD group (VD model rats without LIFUS, n = 6) and VD + LIFUS group (VD model rats with LIFUS treatment, n = 6).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: VD + LIFUS group was treated by LIFUS daily for 14 days starting after 2 weeks’ recovery
